title: mattstack skills bindings manifest
description: Shape shared by a pack's authored pack/skills.jsonc fragment and the per-repo skills.jsonc merge-manifests.sh generates under ~/.mattstack/repos/<slug>/. skills.enabled lists slot skills turned on; pipelines maps a pipeline name to its ordered stage sequence; bindings maps a skill or verb name to the domain skill filling each of its named slots. version is only present on a generated (merged) manifest -- a fragment omits it.

version.description: Present only on a generated per-repo manifest (merge-manifests.sh always stamps 1).

pipelines.description: Pipeline name -> ordered list of stage skill refs.

bindings.description: Skill or verb name -> { slot key -> domain skill ref filling that slot }.

skillRef.description: namespace:name reference to a skill, e.g. "mattstack:model-tiering" or "demo:watch-ci-domain".
